sources.title: Census Subdivisions, Digital Boundary File – 2016 Census
sources.derivation: Stream lcsd000a16a_e.shp/.shx/.dbf from retained ZIP, select PRUID=59 (737 records), transform from embedded Statistics Canada Lambert conformal conic / EPSG:3347 to EPSG:4326, preserving CSDUID/name/type and CD/PR attributes. The full nationwide shapefile member is not expanded or retained separately.
sources.restoration: Download the digital boundary ZIP from the canonical Open Canada dataset entry, verify archive digest, then run prepare_source_extracts.py with pinned dependencies.
limitations: Statistical administrative geography, not a cadastral boundary or independent legal ownership determination.
The official CSD product includes full geographic extent that may include coastal water; this does not explain any particular measured discrepancy.

sources.title: Boundary changes, Census Subdivisions, 2016 to 2021 (Table 1)
sources.restoration: Open the canonical table page and download its CSV link; generated signed/tokenized download URLs are not a stable citation. Preserve the downloaded bytes and compare digest.
limitations: Table note warns that not all changes may be included.
Records report change codes and population, not polygon geometry or area; no area-change causal attribution is made.

sources.title: 2016 Census Dictionary: Census subdivision (CSD)
sources.restoration: Retrieve the canonical dictionary page; compare current page separately because web content may change.
limitations: Defines CSD as a statistical term covering municipalities and municipal-equivalent areas; does not support a sovereignty or political ownership claim.

Name/geometry correspondence is not a legal succession or boundary authority finding.

sources.title: Statistics Canada 2021 Census Subdivisions, British Columbia response retained by #485
sources.restoration: Use the identified official Statistics Canada 2021 CSD item/layer and query British Columbia PRUID=59; retain item/layer metadata, exact query and response date. Do not represent a later service response as the pinned original.
limitations: The full response is an ancestor source; this packet retains assigned target properties and the geometries required to reproduce the 33 inherited low-overlap checks.
Cross-vintage footprint changes are not attributed to a transition event without independent polygon evidence.

methods.invalid_projected_geometry_handling: Temporary Shapely make_valid; original geometries remain unchanged
methods.name_normalization: Unicode NFKD, strip combining marks by ASCII normalization, casefold, remove non-alphanumeric characters
methods.uncertainty: Overlap cutoffs are triage only; statistical source identity does not establish legal authority, land coverage, settlement completeness or political ownership.
